name: Interaction Rules
description: Event-driven interaction rules — attach triggers and actions to surface events

knowledge.purpose: Declarative rules that listen to surface events and run actions (set state, mutate entity, navigate, emit event)
useCases: When form submits successfully, navigate to a confirmation surface
When user clicks a button, open a modal and prefill its data
When entity changes, refresh a dependent table
Conditional show/hide of a block based on form values
antiPatterns: Long imperative scripts — interaction rules should be short and declarative
Hidden side-effects that bypass capability boundaries (e.g. raw fetch instead of persistence)
Cycles where rule A triggers rule B that re-triggers A

fields.label: Execution Mode
fields.description: How behavior actions are executed when a trigger fires

options.label: Synchronous
options.description: Actions block the event chain until complete

options.label: Asynchronous
options.description: Actions run in background without blocking

fields.label: Max Concurrent
fields.description: Maximum number of behaviors that can execute simultaneously

fields.label: Error Policy
fields.description: How errors in behavior actions are handled

options.label: Log
options.description: Log errors to console without stopping execution

options.label: Halt
options.description: Stop the behavior chain on first error

fields.label: Debug Mode
fields.description: Emit detailed trace events for behavior execution
